svg.title: Reported duration response to nominal pressure by grind
svg.desc: 39 dependent contrasts in seconds. D is higher minus lower nominal pressure; I is finer minus coarser D. Lines are conditional h=0.5 second entrywise perturbation ranges, not timing variability. All four strata and separate extreme-grind secondary comparisons are shown.

g.text: Dots: exact printed-value contrasts. Lines: conditional perturbation ranges at h=0.5 s per original condition.
Blue: strictly positive range · red: strictly negative · grey: unresolved. Hollow dot: reported zero (not physical equality).
Native nominal pressure labels; unknown duration statistic / clock / spread. Categorical grinds are not particle-size distances.
PRIMARY: finer D − coarser D · interaction I
SECONDARY ONLY: Cibao Altura · 93.4 °C · Extra Fine / Extra Coarse
Primary: 5 nominal reversal pairs; 0 retain strict reversal at h=0.5 s. Interaction resolution does not imply reversal.
Secondary strict reversal: 0≤h<0.5 s (12−9); 0≤h<3.5 s (12−6). No primary reversal claim from 12-bar evidence.
